searchText: > We initiated the testnet, for the moment only 3 Besu nodes on this network. I am waiting for EIP-1559 support for Clique engine in Geth before deploying Geth nodes. We will likely restart this testnet many times before having something stable. Here are the urls of the stats dashboard and the block explorer: > http://eip1559-testnet.ops.pegasys.tech:3001/ > http://eip1559-testnet.ops.pegasys.tech:3000/ > I will share genesis later when we are ready to open to other nodes. <@!574864862338088960> awesome! > <@!636212126939217941> using DAppNode, it was very easy (once you have the hardware). <@!486501030046203915> ya hardware is my problem 😬 thank you for sharing that, great analysis (also led me to Ethereum-ETL thank you, ouf I was about to re-invent so many wheels lol). > happy to chat more! there are really cool things to explore there <@!486501030046203915> Definitely, will DM you what Im working on Hi everyone, The Forum of EthMagician is organizing a session and they are interested to include 1559 updates/discussion. It seems like a good platform to interact with the community and explains what Fees market change is in simple terms and possibly answer some community questions. Curious to know availability/thoughts on hosting a talk on eip1559 (Fee market change) on the magician sessions. (tentative date and time: 29 July at 5 pm CET)
